title: 2012/04 - Google Indonesia Policy Fellowship
comment: Are you an Indonesian student (undergraduate, postgraduate or doctoral) who is passionate about the dynamic of Internet as a new media in Indonesia? If so, then it is you who we expect to apply as Indonesian Google Policy Fellow hosted by ICT Watch. Indonesian Google Policy Fellowship offers an opportunity for academic, researcher or student in Indonesia to apply for fellow and doing research
